requirements.text: You have 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on backend systems, databases, and API development.
You have a passion for making software more useful through product integrations that make remote work easier and more efficient.
You have developed against a broad set of APIs and can provide meaningful feedback on API designs.
You have a solid understanding of the full web technology stack.
You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
You have experience with cloud-based services, preferably with an understanding of security, scalability, and reliability considerations.
You have ability to collaborate with Product, UX, and other engineering teams to align technical efforts with product vision.
You have excellent problem-solving skills, with a passion for creating developer-friendly products.
You have hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Apache Spark and are comfortable working with large-scale data pipelines and analytics systems.
You bring experience applying machine learning techniques to real-world engineering problems and are passionate about using data to drive decisions.
You have a track record of building quick, functional prototypes and iterating rapidly in ambiguous, greenfield environments.
Experience with Box's platform architecture, APIs, or SDK development is a plus. You have developed an app using the Box APIs
You have experience building scalable, highly-available service oriented architectures.
You have experience in a fast paced, highly collaborative environment.
You have led or contributed to open source projects.
You contribute to developer communities such as Stack Overflow or GitHub.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.
